summary: A lawmaker can help a mill request faster review of a conversion without promising a permit.
realLife: Section 5 gave Washington's ecology department a time-limited direction to prioritize permits for existing mills converting or expanding to make paper bags or their raw material.
inGame: needs: the mill files a qualifying application during the statutory priority period.
gates: The mill files a qualifying application during the statutory priority period.

turns.what: The application receives an earlier review date.
turns.pulledBy: The proposed retooling meets the program's criteria.
turns.writesBack: Staff expedite processing and still review the merits.

turns.what: The permit stays in the regular queue.
turns.pulledBy: The application concerns a different product line.
turns.writesBack: It follows the ordinary permit schedule.
